about: Which stand-in program draws each GML sheet's oracle (written by graph-io/test/fidelity/generators/specimens/gml.py): cytoscape-gml (Cytoscape desktop's GML reader) or gml2gv (gml2gv | neato -n2).

specimen-node-shapes.about: every graphics type of the GML draft

specimen-node-fills-borders.about: fill color syntaxes, outline colors, outline widths, stipples (Tk)

specimen-node-fills-borders-p2.about: yEd fills, gradients, outlines and outline styles

specimen-node-sizes-opacity.about: w and h of the GML draft

specimen-node-sizes-opacity-p2.about: yEd sizes and the alpha of yEd's #RRGGBBAA colors

specimen-labels.about: the node label key of the GML draft

specimen-labels-p2.about: yEd LabelGraphics: fonts, sizes, styles, colors, boxes, alignment

specimen-labels-p3.about: yEd node label models and positions (model, anchor) and free offsets

specimen-edges-lines.about: edge fill, width, Line bends, loops, parallels, smooth, stipple (GML draft and Tk)

specimen-edges-lines-p2.about: yEd edge styles, widths, colors, bends, smoothed bends, arcs, loops

specimen-arrows.about: the arrow key (Tk): which ends have an arrow

specimen-arrows-p2.about: every yEd arrow at the target end

specimen-arrows-p3.about: every yEd arrow at the source end, and arrow colors

specimen-edge-labels.about: the edge label key of the GML draft

specimen-edge-labels-p2.about: yEd edge LabelGraphics: fonts, colors, boxes, models and positions

specimen-groups.about: yEd groups (isGroup, gid): boxes, labels, nesting

specimen-images-charts.about: image and bitmap files (the GML draft)
